suppress.notes: Spring Framework 6.1.21 is the latest release on the 6.1.x line (confirmed: 6.1.22 through 6.1.27 do not exist on Maven Central). The fix for these findings ships in 6.1.28, which requires Spring Boot 3.4.x or later (Boot 3.3.x's dependency management tops out at Framework 6.1.x) - a minor Boot upgrade outside this release-stabilization pass's scope. Re-evaluate when 6.1.28 (or a Spring Boot 3.3.x line that pulls it in) is published.

Spring Security 6.3.10 is the latest release on the 6.3.x line (confirmed: 6.3.11 through 6.3.17 do not exist on Maven Central). The fixes for these findings ship in 6.3.15/6.3.17/6.3.18, which require Spring Boot 3.4.x or later - a minor Boot upgrade outside this release-stabilization pass's scope. Re-evaluate when a fixed 6.3.x release exists.

Spring Boot 3.3.13 is the latest release on the 3.3.x line (confirmed: 3.3.14 through 3.3.18 do not exist on Maven Central). The fixes for these findings ship in 3.3.18/3.3.19, which do not exist yet either - the fix is only available starting with the 3.4.x/3.5.x lines, a minor Boot upgrade outside this release-stabilization pass's scope. Re-evaluate when a fixed 3.3.x release exists.

jackson-databind 2.17.3 is the version Spring Boot 3.3.13 manages; 2.18.4 is the newest release published on Maven Central and is *also* still within the vulnerable range for both CVEs (fix versions are 2.18.8, 2.21.4, or 3.1.4 - none of which are published yet at all, in any line). There is currently no version of jackson-databind, on any line, that fixes this. Re-evaluate once a fixed release exists.
